title: 第17章 直奔下层BOSS第18章 殷血发觉不对劲
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
踏入矿洞，光线骤然暗淡。
外界的声音迅速被隔绝。
唯有不知从何处传来的的水滴声。
空气中弥漫着浓重得化不开的霉味和一股带着腥气的腐朽味道。
四周的岩壁上，覆盖着厚厚的、灰蒙蒙的蛛网。
如同破败的帷幕，层层叠叠。
借助从洞口透进来的微弱光线才能勉强看清前方蜿蜒曲折的矿道。
之前进入矿洞的冒险家已经开始战斗了。
打斗声和叫喊声传来。
林默拿出矿洞的结构图，发现矿洞内的路线十分复杂。
然而，还不等他多看几眼，头顶上方突然传来一阵细微的声响。
他头也没抬，握着黑剑的手臂随意地向上一挥。
嗤！
乌光闪过。
一只从洞顶垂落、体型堪比成年人头颅大小的暗墨蜘蛛摔落。
暗墨蜘蛛在地上滚了两下，随后直接被分成两半。
墨绿色的体液和内脏流了一地，散发出更加浓郁的腥臭。
【击杀10级魔物：暗墨蜘蛛】
【吸收灵魂能量，全属性+2】
冰冷的提示在脑海中响起，微弱的能量融入身体。

几乎在同时。
从矿洞更深的地方，传来了密集得令人头皮发麻的窸窸窣窣声。
仿佛有无数节肢动物正在黑暗中摩擦、爬行。
林默稍微集中精神，高达306的精神属性赋予了他远超常人的感知力。
他能够清晰地感觉到，越往矿洞深处。
那些能量波动就越密集，也越强大。
“正好。”
他心中默念，这符合他的预期。
这些蜘蛛的实力不强，而且数量众多，正好适合黑剑吸收。
他收起手里的矿洞结构图，直接迈开脚步，向着深处疾步而去。
“喂！你等等我！”
苏琳刚刚手忙脚乱地用匕首撬下那只蜘蛛的毒牙。
一抬头就发现林默已经快消失在黑暗的矿道拐角。
连忙压低声音呼喊，快步追了上去。
她紧跟在林默身后，看着他轻松惬意地随手挥剑。
将沿途偶尔扑出的暗墨蜘蛛精准地斩落，动作流畅得没有一丝多余。
心中那个猜测越来越清晰。
content_en:
Stepping into the mine, the light suddenly dimmed.
Outside sounds were quickly cut off.
There was only the sound of water dripping from nowhere.
The air was filled with an indescribable musty smell and a fishy smell of decay.
The surrounding rock walls are covered with thick, gray cobwebs.
Like a broken curtain, layer upon layer.
Only with the faint light coming from the entrance of the cave can we barely see the winding mine tunnel ahead.
The adventurers who had entered the mine before had already started fighting.
There were sounds of fighting and shouting.
Lin Mo took out the structural diagram of the mine and found that the route inside the mine was very complicated.
However, before he could take a few more glances, there was a sudden faint sound above his head.
Without raising his head, he waved the arm holding the black sword upward casually.
laugh!
Dark light flashed.
A dark-ink spider that was as big as an adult's head dropped from the cave ceiling.
The Dark Ink Spider rolled on the ground twice, and then was split into two halves.
Dark green body fluids and internal organs flowed all over the floor, emitting a stronger fishy odor.
[Kill level 10 monster: Dark Ink Spider]
[Absorb soul energy, all attributes +2]
A cold reminder sounded in my mind, and weak energy merged into my body.
Almost at the same time.
From deeper in the mine, there was a dense and numbing rustling sound.
It seemed like countless arthropods were rubbing and crawling in the darkness.
Lin Mo concentrated a little, and his mental attribute of 306 gave him a perception far beyond that of ordinary people.
He could clearly feel it going deeper into the mine.
The denser and more powerful those energy fluctuations are.
"Just right."
He thought to himself that this was in line with his expectations.
These spiders are not very strong and are numerous in number, which is just suitable for Black Sword to absorb.
He put away the mine structure diagram in his hand, took direct steps, and hurried toward the depths.
"Hey! Wait for me!"
Su Lin had just used a dagger to pry off the spider's fangs in a hurry.
When he looked up, he found that Lin Mo had almost disappeared around the corner of the dark mine tunnel.
He quickly lowered his voice and shouted, quickly chasing after him.
She followed Lin Mo closely, watching him swing his sword easily and comfortably.
He accurately chopped down the dark ink spiders that occasionally jumped out along the way, and his movements were so smooth that there was no redundancy.
The guess in my mind became clearer and clearer.
